profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, and traded under the ticker ZBRA, according to its profile. Its site describes it as "the world's foundation for intelligent operations" and says it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate and enhance processes using mobile computers, scanners, printers and RFID. It also describes manufacturing technology solutions built from hardware and software for automation, data analysis and factory connectivity.

On AI, the company describes software for frontline operations that optimizes workflows, streamlines processes and simplifies tasks. Named offerings include Zebra Companion AI, which the company says provides instant, tailored insights and support; Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, described as AI vision models, sample apps and APIs; and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints, described as adaptable frameworks that automate manual tasks. The Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software covers track-and-trace, vision inspection and industrial automation, and Zebra Aurora Focus is presented as an interface for setting up, deploying and running Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra says its AI is an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software and machine vision.

The profile records a CIK of 0000877212 and for-profit public company status. Litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 305 cases. The site's own footer states that the Zebra wordmark and logo are trademarks registered in many jurisdictions, and notes that some content or images may have been created with the assistance of AI.
